transcript:
Casey Demo: Thanks both. Where does the time go at month-end today?
Morgan Placeholder: Insurance remittances. Each clinic downloads them from four portals and someone matches them to invoices in a spreadsheet.
Casey Demo: How long does that take?
Morgan Placeholder: About two days per clinic, and we have eleven clinics.
Dana Sample: And when a remittance file changes format, the spreadsheet macros break and I get pulled in.
Casey Demo: What would you need to see to try something new?
Dana Sample: Anything that touches patient billing needs a HIPAA business associate agreement first. No exceptions.
Morgan Placeholder: And I am wary of per-clinic pricing. Our last vendor charged per location and the bill doubled when we opened four sites.
Casey Demo: We price per remittance source, not per clinic, so new sites do not change the bill. I can send our standard BAA today.
Dana Sample: Then I will review the BAA with legal next week.
Morgan Placeholder: If legal is fine, let's run two clinics as a test in November. I will pick which two.
Casey Demo: I will set up a call for 2026-10-28 to plan the test.
